common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can be retrofitted to the door hardware already fitted, or whether the whole lockset has to be swapped — the Brighton East lock-installation task mix is knob, cam, deadbolt and padlock locks listed alongside smart locks (airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/brighton-east-vic), and the local Brighton East service list pairs 'Change Door Lock' and 'Door Locks Rekey' with the smart-lock services (toplocksmithmelbourne.com.au/brighton-east/locksmith-services-brighton-east-vic).

Choosing between a Bluetooth lock and a Wi-Fi lock — the Brighton East locksmith service list treats 'Bluetooth Locks' and 'Wifi Locks' as two separate line items rather than one smart-lock category (toplocksmithmelbourne.com.au/brighton-east/locksmith-services-brighton-east-vic), so buyers here are being asked to pick a connectivity type before they book.

What the job will actually cost and how to compare offers before committing — the Brighton East demand is being funnelled through a short-form free-quote marketplace flow ('Fill in a short form and get free quotes for local lock installations in Brighton East', airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/brighton-east-vic), so quote transparency is a live purchase blocker.

Who supports the lock after it is installed if it stops working — 'Smart Lock Repair' is advertised as its own service for Brighton East separate from installation (toplocksmithmelbourne.com.au/brighton-east/locksmith-services-brighton-east-vic), and the Melbourne-wide smart-lock installers reachable in Brighton are mobile operators on mobile numbers rather than a local shopfront (newgenlocksmith.com.au/services/smart-lock-installation, 0422 044 436).
